summary: Preserved candidate https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3016 at 4c7768d36ecfa2fb078ad51cfed49932677dfda0 and corrected the relocated-cache counterexample from independent review https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3062. DG_JIT_CACHE_DIR is now excluded from compatibility identity because it is a storage location, while other DG_JIT_* compilation settings remain keyed. A copied completed cache now reuses its existing marker instead of repeating exhaustive all-M warmup.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction against the exact candidate: copying the cache to a different DG_JIT_CACHE_DIR caused a second exhaustive warmup call.
All 13 marker regressions passed after correction, including a real filesystem copy between different cache roots and preservation of all candidate compatibility/failure tests.
All applicable formatting, lint, safety, and registered-test validation hooks passed.
The assigned device is AMD Instinct MI350X with ROCm 7.2; torch.version.cuda is None and deep_gemm is not installed.

gpu_execution_evidence: Only a read-only hardware/import probe ran. No GPU kernel was executed because the available device is AMD/ROCm and DeepGEMM is unavailable.
remaining_limitations: Real NVIDIA DeepGEMM JIT compilation and restored-artifact loading were not run because the prepared node has AMD/ROCm hardware and no deep_gemm installation.
Independent CUDA numerical comparison, CUDA graph capture/instantiation parity, DeepSeek-V4-Pro TP=8 startup behavior, and startup performance remain unverified.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
